reports.title: Harvey Milk Wrote Letters Defending Jim Jones — Dan Flynn
reports.description:
Before Jim Jones convinced 900 people to drink poison in South America, he convinced the most powerful politicians in San Francisco to drink the Kool-Aid first.

Daniel Flynn — Hoover Institution visiting fellow and author of "Cult City: Jim Jones, Harvey Milk, and Ten Days That Shook San Francisco" — joins John Curley to explain the political machine that enabled Jones, the letters Harvey Milk wrote defending him to President Carter, and why the politicians who aided and abetted a death cult have buildings named after them while the 900 people who died have no memorial in San Francisco.

Listen to The John Curley Show every weekday at 3pm on KIRO Newsradio 97.3 FM. Listen to KIRO Newsradio 97.3 FM, or visit MyNorthwest.com to learn more!
